implemented_requirements.evidence: No code defines a Tetromino class or automatic falling; tetromino.py only contains a raw matrix and lacks shape definitions.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can move pieces before they land
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.move(dx, dy) attempts to move the current piece after checking board.is_valid_position.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can rotate pieces before they land
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.rotate() creates a rotated candidate and applies simple wall‑kick checks.
Board.clear_lines() removes full rows and Game.lock_current_piece() calls it.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Scoring increases with line clears and drops
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.lock_current_piece() adds LINE_SCORES, Game.soft_drop() and Game.hard_drop() add per‑cell scores.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends when no more pieces can be placed
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.spawn_piece() checks board.is_top_reached() and sets STATE_GAME_OVER.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Board updates after each move or drop
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.move updates current_piece; Game.lock_current_piece updates the board grid via Board.lock_piece.

implemented_requirements.requirement: All seven standard Tetromino shapes are included
implemented_requirements.evidence: tetromino.py does not define BASE_SHAPES, shape_matrix, or a Tetromino class; only a three‑line matrix is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Drop speed increases as the game progresses
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.drop_interval() computes interval based on level; level rises with cleared lines.

critical_issues: Missing Tetromino class and shape definitions (BASE_SHAPES, shape_matrix) – core gameplay cannot run.
No entry point or main game loop; main.py only contains duplicate key repeat constants.
No pygame initialization or event handling, so the renderer cannot be exercised.
tetromino.py is incomplete/truncated, providing no usable piece data.
judge.summary: The repository contains substantial game‑logic scaffolding (board management, scoring, level progression, rendering helpers) and implements movement, rotation, line clearing, and speed scaling. However, the essential Tetromino implementation is absent, and there is no runnable main loop or pygame setup. Consequently the core requirement of a functional falling Tetris game with all seven pieces cannot be satisfied, leading to a fail verdict.
